prompt: As of the financial year ending July 31st 2023, what was the size of the endowment at the university attended by rugby player Fred McLeod?
answer: Fred McLeod attended the **University of Edinburgh**. According to the University’s 2022–23 financial statements, its endowment was valued at **£559.8 million as of 31 July 2023**.
